brief.topic: When life feels uncertain: trust in Allah
brief.audience: Muslims who want a short, trustworthy daily reminder they can act on

coreInsight: Qur'an 65:3 says whoever relies on Allah, He is sufficient for him, so we can keep moving without seeing every step.

hooks.notes: Clear in two seconds; the teaching answers it.

selectionRationale: Most relevant and clearest at a glance; the teaching pays it off.

scenes.onScreen: When life feels uncertain… / You don't need to see every step.
scenes.sub: You don't need to see every step.

scenes.purpose: Teaching: the source, verbatim, with its reference.
scenes.excerpt: And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him
scenes.arabicExcerpt: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسۡبُهُۥٓۚ

resolved.arabic: وَيَرۡزُقۡهُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَحۡتَسِبُۚ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسۡبُهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَٰلِغُ أَمۡرِهِۦۚ قَدۡ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدۡرࣰ ا ٣
resolved.english: And will provide for him from where he does not expect. And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allah will accomplish His purpose. Allah has already set for everything a [decreed] extent
resolved.transliteration: Wayarzuqhu min haythu la yahtasibu waman yatawakkal AAala Allahi fahuwa hasbuhu inna Allaha balighu amrihi qad jaAAala Allahu likulli shayin qadran

scenes.onScreen: REFLECTION / Trust, then take the next step. / Tawakkul isn't waiting with folded hands. It is doing what you can today and leaving what you can't see to Allah. You don't have to know every step ahead to keep moving forward.
body: Tawakkul isn't waiting with folded hands. It is doing what you can today and leaving what you can't see to Allah.
You don't have to know every step ahead to keep moving forward.

caption.opening: You don't have to know every step ahead to keep moving forward.
body: Qur'an 65:3 is a reminder that whoever relies on Allah, He is sufficient for him.
Tawakkul isn't waiting with folded hands: do what you can today, and leave what you can't see to Allah.

claims.text: Doing what we can and trusting Allah with the rest is our reflection on the ayah.
